mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve (10Y-2Y spread < 0) combined with rising consumer prices (CPI > 3%) signals a potential monetary policy error that could lead to a recession and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months when the yield curve is inverted and CPI > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that could lead to stagflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by > 2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances when HOUST declines by > 10% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in initial jobless claims signals a weakening labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when ICSA rises by > 20% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that could lead to a recession and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by > 1% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines by > 5% in 3 months.
